text:
World of Tanks Modern Armor - Steel Asylum Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/world-of-tanks/

Beware, Commander: the battlefield has descended into madness. 

Step into Steel Asylum, the latest season of World of Tanks Modern Armor, and face 100 Stages packed with rewards worthy of those brave enough to confront the unknown. Earn Gold, War Chests, Premium Account time, Premium tanks, and more as you fight your way through a season where fear lurks around every corner. 

Unlock the Season Pass and make your escape with the VCC-80/60, an Escalation Era Light Tank built to strike from the shadows and keep enemies guessing. Looking for an even greater advantage? The Ultimate Season Pass immediately grants you the Serpente — a deadly Tier IX medium tank ready to spread panic across the battlefield — and Desmond "Doc" Rose, a 3D Hero Commander whose unsettling expertise may be exactly what you need to survive the chaos ahead. 

But the horrors of Steel Asylum are only beginning. Prepare for chilling Halloween festivities, incredible Black Friday opportunities, and two mysterious sci-fi events that will challenge your perception of reality itself. 

Face your fears and tame the insanity: the Steel Asylum season begins on October 6 on PlayStation!

BrokenLore: Miki-Chan - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018738/ 

BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN is coming to PS5.

First introduced in BrokenLore: DON’T LIE, Miki-chan now stars in her own first-person psychological horror game.

Set in a Japanese school, face Miki-chan, a virtual AI assistant who becomes increasingly jealous, possessive, and obsessive. Explore a distorted school simulation, use the Rewriter to alter reality, and uncover a new piece of the mystery behind BrokenLore.

text:
Signal Veil - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020814/ 

SIGNAL VEIL is a classic-style psychological survival horror game.

After inheriting her mother’s old phone, Aki begins experiencing supernatural phenomena no one else can see. As her seemingly ordinary school reveals a disturbing past buried beneath false memories and silence, Aki must confront grotesque spirits, impossible messages, and a fractured reality.

Explore tense environments through classic fixed camera angles, use Aki’s phone to detect supernatural entities and reveal what cannot normally be seen, and survive with limited resources and tactical combat.

Listen to the signal. Face what lies beyond the veil.

#ps5 #ps5games
